map.输入原液浓度、目标浓度与需要配制的总量，计算原液与水的用量及稀释倍数。: Input stock concentration, target concentration and total volume to compute stock and water amounts and dilution factor.
map.💡 公式（质量守恒 C₁V₁=C₂V₂）：原液用量 = 目标浓度 ÷ 原液浓度: 💡 Formula (mass conservation C₁V₁=C₂V₂): stock amount = target ÷ stock × total; water added = total − stock; dilution factor = stock ÷ target.
map.原液浓度须大于目标浓度，否则无需稀释或无法配制: Stock concentration must exceed target, otherwise no dilution needed or impossible
map.浓度与总量单位需一致（均按体积/质量百分比计）: Concentration and volume units must be consistent (all by volume/mass percentage)
map.浓硫酸等特殊药品稀释请遵循\"酸入水\"等专业操作规范: For special chemicals like concentrated sulfuric acid, follow professional rules such as "acid into water"
map.📚 深度解析：溶液稀释配比计算（原液/加水量）: 📚 Deep Dive: Solution Dilution Ratio (Stock / Water)
map.试剂/农药/消毒液配制：按原液浓度与目标浓度求取原液与加水量: Reagent/pesticide/disinfectant preparation: from stock and target concentration get stock and water amounts
map.批量配制：由需要总量反算各组分体积: Batch preparation: back-solve each component volume from total
map.稀释倍数换算：给出 1:N 配比便于操作: Dilution-factor conversion: give 1:N ratio for operation
map.原液用量=目标浓度÷原液浓度×需要总量；加水量=需要总量−原液用量；稀释倍数=原: Stock amount=target÷stock×total; water added=total−stock; dilution factor=stock÷target, written as 1 : factor. Require target < stock and both >0.
map.原液浓度 20%、目标 0.5%、需要总量 10 L：原液=0.5÷20×10=: Stock 20%, target 0.5%, total 10 L: stock=0.5÷20×10=0.25 L (250 mL), water=9.75 L (9750 mL), dilution factor=40, ratio 1 : 40.
map.目标浓度能等于或大于原液吗？: Can target equal or exceed stock?
map.不能。稀释是降低浓度，目标必须严格小于原液浓度，否则无解（浓缩需另法）；浓度为负: No. Dilution lowers concentration; target must be strictly less than stock, otherwise no solution (concentration needs another method); negative concentration is meaningless.
map.表示 1 份原液兑 40 份总液（即 1 份原液 + 39 份水），与\"原液: It means 1 part stock to 40 parts total liquid (i.e. 1 part stock + 39 parts water), consistent with "stock 0.25L + water 9.75L" — measure by volume ratio on site.
map.稀释配比计算器依据溶液稀释原理 C₁V₁=C₂V₂，根据原液浓度、目标浓度与配制: Dilution ratio calculator uses the dilution principle C₁V₁=C₂V₂; from stock concentration, target concentration and total volume it quickly computes stock and water amounts and dilution factor, for lab solution prep, pesticide mixing and disinfectant dilution.
map.同时输出原液与水用量: Outputs both stock and water amounts
